took_check: ⛔ THE ZERO IS NOT A SKIPPED COMPUTATION. The repeat's emitted tokens are BYTE-IDENTICAL to a fresh bind's (greedy, fixed input) across three binaries and all four arms; an OFF-arm positive control emits DIFFERENT tokens in the same run; gc0_on/gc0_off blob md5s pinned unchanged; base weight.bin md5 constant. Fast-and-different would be a silent fallback to base/stale weights — that is the failure this gate exists to exclude, and it did not occur.
notes: ⇒ The operationally relevant switch cost is per ADAPTER CHANGE, not per inference. A cost model charging every request overstates it by the request count. ⚠️ SCOPE: this is the call-level bind only; the GDN graph's separate per-FORWARD mutable-buffer re-add is untouched and open.
